title: Asked by vg-paradigms: CI by hand, not on every push (rule ci.on-demand)
body:
CI by hand, not on every push (rule ci.on-demand) (graft:01a19343-2e20..649c, from vg-paradigms)

What was needed:
- vg-paradigms: .github/workflows/check.yml: drop `push: branches: [main]`, keeping `pull_request:` and `workflow_dispatch:`. Only the user commits to vg-dotfiles, so its checks run locally before every commit and CI runs by hand (`gh workflow run check.yml`).

Answer (done): Done as your update asks: .github/workflows/check.yml is deleted. Nothing it checked is dropped: its steps moved into nix/scripts/check.sh (`just check`), which runs locally before every commit on any Linux machine with Nix (vghydra: wsl -d NixOS -- bash nix/scripts/check.sh). It evaluates every host, checks the exports, builds vgwsl2's home-files, and runs shellcheck and the script tests. All six steps passed on vgwsl2 on 2026-10-31, and a control with a failing step exits 1. The claim on vg-dotfiles / Composition says this now, replacing the CI one.
